name: Chicken Shawarma
description: Home-style chicken shawarma with yogurt-marinated spiced chicken, browned in a hot pan and wrapped in warm flatbread with crisp vegetables and garlic sauce.
method: Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, oil, cumin, paprika, coriander, black pepper and salt into a smooth marinade. Coat the chicken thoroughly, cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Take out only the chicken you are ready to cook. Heat a wide pan or grill pan over medium-high heat until properly hot before adding the first batch.
Cook the chicken in uncrowded batches so released moisture can evaporate and the strips develop browned edges instead of steaming.
Turn the pieces as needed and continue until the chicken is fully cooked through. Check the thickest pieces rather than relying only on exterior colour.
Rest the cooked chicken briefly, then cut larger pieces into easy-to-eat strips if necessary. Warm the flatbreads separately so they bend without tearing.
Layer cabbage, cucumber and hot chicken over each flatbread, add garlic sauce, roll tightly and serve immediately so the vegetables stay crisp.
tips: Marinate chicken in the refrigerator, not at room temperature.
Avoid overcrowding the pan so the chicken develops browned edges.
storage: Cool leftover cooked chicken promptly and refrigerate it covered. Store vegetables and sauce separately and assemble fresh wraps only when serving.
